reproduction_target: Reproduce the computational analyses of the khill_complexity method paper: (1) compute KHILL / block-entropy / excess-entropy / transient-information across all bacterial RefSeq (v223) taxa with >=2 genomes and across k-mer sizes with the khill_complexity program; (2) clade-specific analyses on random subsamples (up to 1000 genomes) of 5 pathogen species and on the 129 Dewar et al. taxa; (3) R linear regressions of KHILL/TI vs pangenome fluidity and genome size; (4) SimBac genome simulations (1000 x 1 Mbase) under varying mutation/recombination rates; (5) runtime benchmarking vs traditional gene-centric pangenomics using prokka annotation + roary orthology on 100 random genomes.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods ('The program', 'Refseq and clade analyses', 'Simulations and annotations'). This is a tool/methods paper whose central artifact is the khill_complexity program. The program's repository is NAMED in prose (https://github.com/narechan/khill_complexity) but returns HTTP 404 at assessment time (also 404 via authenticated gh api; a separate older repo narechan/khill exists but is NOT the cited artifact and was not substituted). No Data availability or Code availability section beyond the inline GitHub URL; data source is public NCBI RefSeq v223 (no per-genome accession list or random-selection seed provided). No custom analysis scripts (R regression code, download/subsampling driver) are provided. All C-layer steps; W=0 (pure computational).

steps.label: khill_complexity: KHILL / block-entropy / excess-entropy / transient-information over a directory of per-genome FASTA at k=1-20, murmurhash3 bottom-k sketching (example: -i genomes -t taxon -k 1-20 -p 10 -x 2 -n 100)

RefSeq (v223) genome acquisition: all bacterial taxa with >=2 genomes (10,510 taxa); random subsample up to 1000 assemblies for S. agalactiae, M. tuberculosis, S. aureus, N. meningitidis, H. pylori; all genomes for 129 Dewar et al. taxa
R linear regressions (fitted + residual components): KHILL vs pangenome fluidity, fluidity vs genome size, KHILL vs genome size, transient information vs genome size
SimBac simulation of 1000 x 1 Mbase genomes under varying mutation/recombination rates (example: recombination 0.0001, mutation 0.01)
prokka annotation of 100 random genomes from the 129 Dewar et al. taxa (benchmarking baseline)
roary ortholog / pangenome construction on the prokka annotations (benchmarking baseline)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: NI ceiling on all 6/6 computational steps. No step reaches RI at stage1: (a) the central tool khill_complexity carries no version tag / release / lockfile and its named repository returns HTTP 404, so its code axis is unreachable and version axis is floating; (b) prokka, roary, SimBac carry no version numbers; (c) no analysis scripts (RefSeq download/subsampling, R regressions) are provided; (d) genome subsampling ('random up to 1000') and SimBac simulation carry no random seed, so exact input sets are not reconstructable. No env lockfile or container is claimed anywhere, so capture_claim=none and stage2_candidate=false; even under a hypothetical stage2 no step could exceed RI without an executed environment capture, and none is claimed.
